data.narrative:
Neko Health is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $326M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit at similar stage.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $400M total-raised proxy as a base and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $680M. Peer-median valuation across the 3 same-sector, same-stage private comparables produces $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B (New Limit) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (8.1x median across the 3 public tickers) is not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $578M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median implied value of $2.2B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in peer selection within an early-stage biotech cohort where stage and funding alone poorly predict outcome value. Key sensitivities include the target's clinical or commercial progress relative to peers and capital efficiency relative to raised amounts.
